name: Install on k3s
note: From an empty cluster to a running agent.

steps.label: kubectl apply -k deploy/kubernetes
steps.say: The manifests in deploy/kubernetes, already checked against the real APIs. A Helm chart later wraps the same objects with values for capabilities and storage class.

steps.label: apply StatefulSets, postgresql k2-pg, Gateway
steps.say: Standard objects plus the Zalando postgres-operator's postgresql object. agent-sandbox CRDs are needed only for the opt-in Sandbox tier.

steps.label: start controller
steps.say: The controller finds Postgres through a Secret and reports its capabilities.

steps.label: start host pods
steps.say: Host pods carry a bootstrap enrollment token from a Secret.

steps.label: enroll
steps.say: Hosts dial in. No Service needs to point at host pods.

steps.label: k2 users add, k2 connect login
steps.say: The same first-run steps as a Linux box today.
